The Spaces

Our indoor spaces have been thoughtfully curated to being cosy, and yet spacious. Rustic and yet luxurious. They include two en-suite bedrooms, two one-bedroom cottages, a lounge and dining area with wood-burning fire places in the lounge and cottages.

The outdoor spaces include our plantation of poplars, kinoos and crops, a verdant lawn and a swimming-pool area including a deck and bar, with stunning views of the plantation.
